columns.name: v
columns.meaning: The trading volume of the symbol in the given time period.

columns.name: vw
columns.meaning: The volume weighted average price.

columns.name: o
columns.meaning: The open price for the symbol in the given time period.

columns.name: c
columns.meaning: The close price for the symbol in the given time period.

columns.name: h
columns.meaning: The highest price for the symbol in the given time period.

columns.name: l
columns.meaning: The lowest price for the symbol in the given time period.

columns.name: t
columns.meaning: The Unix millisecond timestamp for the start of the aggregate window.

columns.name: n
columns.meaning: The number of transactions in the aggregate window.

columns.name: trade_date
columns.meaning: 交易日期（通常为 YYYY-MM-DD）。

columns.name: id
columns.meaning: Unique identifier for each dividend record

columns.name: ticker
columns.meaning: The ticker symbol of the IPO event.

columns.name: record_date
columns.meaning: Date when shareholders must be on record to be eligible for the dividend payment

columns.name: pay_date
columns.meaning: Date when the dividend payment is distributed to shareholders

columns.name: ex_dividend_date
columns.meaning: Date when the stock begins trading without the dividend value
columns.meaning_zh: 除息日（含息转为除息交易的日期）。

columns.name: frequency
columns.meaning: How many times per year this dividend is expected to occur. A value of 0 means the distribution is non-recurring or irregular (e.g., special, supplemental, or a one-off dividend). Other possible values include 1 (annual), 2 (semi-annual), 3 (trimester), 4 (quarterly), 12 (monthly), 24 (bi-monthly), 52 (weekly), 104 (bi-weekly), and 365 (daily) depending on the issuer's declared or inferred payout cadence.
columns.meaning_zh: 分红频率（每年分红次数，如 1=年、4=季、12=月）。

columns.name: cash_amount
columns.meaning: Original dividend amount per share in the specified currency

columns.name: currency
columns.meaning: Currency code for the dividend payment (e.g., USD, CAD)

columns.name: distribution_type
columns.meaning: Classification describing the nature of this dividend's recurrence pattern: recurring (paid on a regular schedule), special (one-time or commemorative), supplemental (extra beyond the regular schedule), irregular (unpredictable or non-recurring), unknown (cannot be classified from available data)
columns.meaning_zh: 分红类型（经常性、特别分红、补充分红、不规则等）。

columns.name: ticker
columns.meaning: The ticker symbol of the IPO event.

columns.name: last_updated
columns.meaning: The date when the IPO event was last modified.

columns.name: announced_date
columns.meaning: The date when the IPO event was announced.

columns.name: issuer_name
columns.meaning: Name of issuer.

columns.name: currency_code
columns.meaning: Underlying currency of the security.

columns.name: final_issue_price
columns.meaning: The price set by the company and its underwriters before the IPO goes live.

columns.name: max_shares_offered
columns.meaning: The upper limit of the shares that the company is offering to investors.

columns.name: lowest_offer_price
columns.meaning: The lowest price within the IPO price range that the company is willing to offer its shares to investors.

columns.name: highest_offer_price
columns.meaning: The highest price within the IPO price range that the company might use to price the shares.

columns.name: total_offer_size
columns.meaning: The total amount raised by the company for IPO.

columns.name: primary_exchange
columns.meaning: Market Identifier Code (MIC) of the primary exchange where the security is listed. The Market Identifier Code (MIC) (ISO 10383) is a unique identification code used to identify securities trading exchanges, regulated and non-regulated trading markets.
columns.meaning_zh: 主上市交易所（MIC 代码）。

columns.name: shares_outstanding
columns.meaning: The total number of shares that the company has issued and are held by investors.

columns.name: security_type
columns.meaning: The classification of the stock. For example, "CS" stands for Common Stock.

columns.name: lot_size
columns.meaning: The minimum number of shares that can be bought or sold in a single transaction.
columns.meaning_zh: 最小交易单位（每手股数）。

columns.name: security_description
columns.meaning: Description of the security.

columns.name: ipo_status
columns.meaning: The status of the IPO event. IPO events start out as status "rumor" or "pending". On listing day, the status changes to "new". After the listing day, the status changes to "history".  The status "direct_listing_process" corresponds to a type of offering where, instead of going through all the IPO processes, the company decides to list its shares directly on an exchange, without using an investment bank or other intermediaries. This is called a direct listing, direct placement, or direct public offering (DPO).

columns.name: us_code
columns.meaning: This is a unique nine-character alphanumeric code that identifies a North American financial security for the purposes of facilitating clearing and settlement of trades.
columns.meaning_zh: 北美证券识别码（九位字母数字编码）。

columns.name: isin
columns.meaning: International Securities Identification Number. This is a unique twelve-digit code that is assigned to every security issuance in the world.

columns.name: min_shares_offered
columns.meaning: The lower limit of shares that the company is willing to sell in the IPO.

columns.name: listing_date
columns.meaning: First trading date for the newly listed entity.

columns.name: id
columns.meaning: Unique identifier for each dividend record

columns.name: execution_date
columns.meaning: Date when the stock split was applied and shares adjusted

columns.name: split_from
columns.meaning: Denominator of the split ratio (old shares)

columns.name: split_to
columns.meaning: Numerator of the split ratio (new shares)

columns.name: ticker
columns.meaning: The ticker symbol of the IPO event.

columns.name: adjustment_type
columns.meaning: Classification of the share-change event. Possible values include: forward_split (share count increases), reverse_split (share count decreases), stock_dividend (shares issued as a dividend)
columns.meaning_zh: 调整类型（前复权拆股/反向拆股/股票股利等）。

columns.name: historical_adjustment_factor
columns.meaning: Cumulative adjustment factor used to offset dividend effects on historical prices. To adjust a historical price for dividends: for a price on date D, find the first dividend whose `ex_dividend_date` is after date D and multiply the price by that dividend's `historical_adjustment_factor`.
columns.meaning_zh: 历史调整因子（用于将历史价格按当前股本口径调整）。

columns.name: primary_category
columns.meaning: Top-level risk category

columns.name: secondary_category
columns.meaning: Mid-level risk category

columns.name: tertiary_category
columns.meaning: Most specific risk classification

columns.name: description
columns.meaning: Detailed explanation of what this risk category encompasses, including specific examples and potential impacts

columns.name: taxonomy
columns.meaning: Version identifier (e.g., '1.0', '1.1') for the taxonomy

sample_rows.description: Risk from inadequate performance management systems, unclear accountability structures, or ineffective measurement and incentive systems that could affect employee performance, goal achievement, and organizational effectiveness.

Risk from poor internal communication, lack of coordination between departments or business units, or information silos that could affect operational efficiency, strategic execution, and organizational alignment and performance.

Risk from inadequate organizational structure, unclear reporting relationships, or ineffective management hierarchies that could create communication problems, decision-making delays, accountability gaps, and operational inefficiencies.

columns.name: cik
columns.meaning: SEC Central Index Key (CIK) identifying the filing entity.

columns.name: ticker
columns.meaning: The ticker symbol of the IPO event.

columns.meaning: Mid-level risk category

columns.name: tertiary_category
columns.meaning: Most specific risk classification

columns.name: filing_date
columns.meaning: Date when the filing was submitted to the SEC (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD).

columns.name: supporting_text
columns.meaning: Snippet of text to support the given label
columns.meaning_zh: 支持该标签的文本片段。

sample_rows.supporting_text: Emerging digital assets and technologies may disrupt our business and adversely affect our results. Rapid innovation in financial technology - including stablecoins and other digital assets, distributed ledger technologies, real-time payment networks, embedded banking, and artificial intelligence - may change how consumers and businesses store value, make payments, access credit, and obtain financial services.

Changes in regulation or oversight may have a material adverse impact on our operations. We are subject to extensive regulation, supervision and examination by the Federal Reserve, the FDIC, the Michigan DIFS, the SEC and other regulatory bodies. Such regulation and supervision govern the activities in which we may engage.

We are also susceptible to cybersecurity risks faced by third party vendors on which we rely for components of our business infrastructure and data processing and which often have access to the sensitive data of our customers.

columns.name: cik
columns.meaning: SEC Central Index Key (CIK) identifying the filing entity.

columns.name: issuer_name
columns.meaning: Name of issuer.

columns.name: filing_url
columns.meaning: Direct URL to the filing on the SEC EDGAR website.

columns.name: accession_number
columns.meaning: SEC accession number uniquely identifying the filing (e.g., '0000320193-24-000123').
columns.meaning_zh: 该字段中文释义已补充。

columns.name: ticker
columns.meaning: The ticker symbol of the IPO event.

columns.name: form_type
columns.meaning_zh: SEC 表单类型（如 10-K/10-Q/8-K/S-1 等）。

columns.name: filing_date
columns.meaning: Date when the filing was submitted to the SEC (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD).

columns.name: accounts_payable
columns.meaning: Amounts owed to suppliers and vendors for goods and services purchased on credit.

columns.name: accrued_and_other_current_liabilities
columns.meaning: Current liabilities not classified elsewhere, including accrued expenses, taxes payable, and other obligations due within one year.

columns.name: accumulated_other_comprehensive_income
columns.meaning: Cumulative gains and losses that bypass the income statement, including foreign currency translation adjustments and unrealized gains/losses on securities.

columns.name: additional_paid_in_capital
columns.meaning: Amount received from shareholders in excess of the par or stated value of shares issued.
columns.meaning_zh: 资本公积（超面值实收资本）。

columns.name: cash_and_equivalents
columns.meaning: Cash on hand and short-term, highly liquid investments that are readily convertible to known amounts of cash.

columns.name: cik
columns.meaning: SEC Central Index Key (CIK) identifying the filing entity.

columns.name: commitments_and_contingencies
columns.meaning: Disclosed amount related to contractual commitments and potential liabilities that may arise from uncertain future events.

columns.name: common_stock
columns.meaning: Par or stated value of common shares outstanding representing basic ownership in the company.

columns.name: debt_current
columns.meaning: Short-term borrowings and the current portion of long-term debt due within one year.
columns.meaning_zh: 一年内到期债务/短期债务。

columns.name: deferred_revenue_current
columns.meaning: Customer payments received in advance for goods or services to be delivered within one year.

columns.name: filing_date
columns.meaning: Date when the filing was submitted to the SEC (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD).

columns.name: fiscal_quarter
columns.meaning: The fiscal quarter number (1, 2, 3, or 4) for the reporting period.

columns.name: fiscal_year
columns.meaning: The fiscal year for the reporting period.

columns.name: goodwill
columns.meaning: Intangible asset representing the excess of purchase price over fair value of net assets acquired in business combinations.

columns.name: intangible_assets_net
columns.meaning: Intangible assets other than goodwill, including patents, trademarks, and customer relationships, net of accumulated amortization.

columns.name: inventories
columns.meaning: Raw materials, work-in-process, and finished goods held for sale in the ordinary course of business.

columns.name: long_term_debt_and_capital_lease_obligations
columns.meaning: Long-term borrowings and capital lease obligations with maturities greater than one year.
columns.meaning_zh: 长期债务及资本租赁义务。

columns.name: noncontrolling_interest
columns.meaning: Equity in consolidated subsidiaries not owned by the parent company, representing minority shareholders' ownership.
columns.meaning_zh: 少数股东权益（非控股权益）。

columns.name: other_assets
columns.meaning: Non-current assets not classified elsewhere, including long-term investments, deferred tax assets, and other long-term assets.

columns.name: other_current_assets
columns.meaning: Current assets not classified elsewhere, including prepaid expenses, taxes receivable, and other assets expected to be converted to cash within one year.

columns.name: other_equity
columns.meaning: Equity components not classified elsewhere in shareholders' equity.

columns.name: other_noncurrent_liabilities
columns.meaning: Non-current liabilities not classified elsewhere, including deferred tax liabilities, pension obligations, and other long-term liabilities.

columns.name: period_end
columns.meaning: The last date of the reporting period, representing the specific point in time when the balance sheet snapshot was taken.

columns.name: preferred_stock
columns.meaning: Par or stated value of preferred shares outstanding with preferential rights over common stock.

columns.name: property_plant_equipment_net
columns.meaning: Tangible fixed assets used in operations, reported net of accumulated depreciation.

columns.name: receivables
columns.meaning: Amounts owed to the company by customers and other parties, primarily accounts receivable, net of allowances for doubtful accounts.

columns.name: retained_earnings_deficit
columns.meaning: Cumulative net income earned by the company less dividends paid to shareholders since inception.

columns.name: short_term_investments
columns.meaning: Marketable securities and other investments with maturities of one year or less that are not classified as cash equivalents.

columns.name: tickers
columns.meaning: A list of ticker symbols under which the company is listed. Multiple symbols may indicate different share classes for the same company.
columns.meaning_zh: 证券代码列表（可能包含多股类别）。

columns.name: timeframe
columns.meaning: The reporting period type. Possible values include: quarterly, annual.
columns.meaning_zh: 报告周期类型（季度/年度等）。

columns.name: total_assets
columns.meaning: Sum of all current and non-current assets representing everything the company owns or controls.

columns.name: total_current_assets
columns.meaning: Sum of all current assets expected to be converted to cash, sold, or consumed within one year.

columns.name: total_current_liabilities
columns.meaning: Sum of all liabilities expected to be settled within one year.

columns.name: total_equity
columns.meaning: Sum of all equity components representing shareholders' total ownership interest in the company.

columns.name: total_equity_attributable_to_parent
columns.meaning: Total shareholders' equity attributable to the parent company, excluding noncontrolling interests.
columns.meaning_zh: 归属于母公司股东权益。

columns.name: total_liabilities
columns.meaning: Sum of all current and non-current liabilities representing everything the company owes.

columns.name: total_liabilities_and_equity
columns.meaning: Sum of total liabilities and total equity, which should equal total assets per the fundamental accounting equation.

columns.name: treasury_stock
columns.meaning: Cost of the company's own shares that have been repurchased and are held in treasury, typically reported as a negative value.

columns.name: cash_from_operating_activities_continuing_operations
columns.meaning: Cash generated from continuing business operations before discontinued operations.
columns.meaning_zh: 持续经营活动产生的经营现金流。

columns.name: change_in_cash_and_equivalents
columns.meaning: Net change in cash and cash equivalents during the period, representing the sum of operating, investing, and financing cash flows plus currency effects.
columns.meaning_zh: 现金及现金等价物净变动。

columns.name: change_in_other_operating_assets_and_liabilities_net
columns.meaning: Net change in working capital components including accounts receivable, inventory, accounts payable, and other operating items.
columns.meaning_zh: 其他经营性资产负债净变动。

columns.name: cik
columns.meaning: SEC Central Index Key (CIK) identifying the filing entity.

columns.name: depreciation_depletion_and_amortization
columns.meaning: Non-cash charges for the reduction in value of tangible and intangible assets over time.

columns.name: dividends
columns.meaning: Cash payments to shareholders in the form of dividends, typically reported as negative values.

columns.name: effect_of_currency_exchange_rate
columns.meaning: Impact of foreign exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents denominated in foreign currencies.
columns.meaning_zh: 汇率变动对现金的影响。

columns.name: filing_date
columns.meaning: Date when the filing was submitted to the SEC (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD).

columns.name: fiscal_quarter
columns.meaning: The fiscal quarter number (1, 2, 3, or 4) for the reporting period.

columns.name: fiscal_year
columns.meaning: The fiscal year for the reporting period.

columns.name: income_loss_from_discontinued_operations
columns.meaning: After-tax income or loss from business operations that have been discontinued.

columns.name: long_term_debt_issuances_repayments
columns.meaning: Net cash flows from issuing or repaying long-term debt obligations.
columns.meaning_zh: 长期债务发行与偿还净额。

columns.name: net_cash_from_financing_activities
columns.meaning: Total cash generated or used by financing activities, including debt issuance, debt repayment, dividends, and share transactions.

columns.name: net_cash_from_financing_activities_continuing_operations
columns.meaning: Cash flows from financing activities of continuing operations before discontinued operations.
columns.meaning_zh: 持续经营筹资现金流净额。

columns.name: net_cash_from_financing_activities_discontinued_operations
columns.meaning: Cash flows from financing activities of discontinued business segments.
columns.meaning_zh: 终止经营筹资现金流净额。

columns.name: net_cash_from_investing_activities
columns.meaning: Total cash generated or used by investing activities, including capital expenditures, acquisitions, and asset sales.

columns.name: net_cash_from_investing_activities_continuing_operations
columns.meaning: Cash flows from investing activities of continuing operations before discontinued operations.
columns.meaning_zh: 持续经营投资现金流净额。

columns.name: net_cash_from_investing_activities_discontinued_operations
columns.meaning: Cash flows from investing activities of discontinued business segments.
columns.meaning_zh: 终止经营投资现金流净额。

columns.name: net_cash_from_operating_activities
columns.meaning: Total cash generated or used by operating activities, representing cash flow from core business operations.

columns.name: net_cash_from_operating_activities_discontinued_operations
columns.meaning: Cash flows from operating activities of discontinued business segments.
columns.meaning_zh: 终止经营经营现金流净额。

columns.name: net_income
columns.meaning: Net income used as the starting point for operating cash flow calculations.

columns.name: noncontrolling_interests
columns.meaning: Cash flows related to minority shareholders in consolidated subsidiaries.
columns.meaning_zh: 少数股东相关现金流项目。

columns.name: other_cash_adjustments
columns.meaning: Other miscellaneous adjustments to cash flows not classified elsewhere.

columns.name: other_financing_activities
columns.meaning: Cash flows from financing activities not classified elsewhere, including share repurchases and other equity transactions.

columns.name: other_investing_activities
columns.meaning: Cash flows from investing activities not classified elsewhere, including acquisitions, divestitures, and investments.

columns.name: other_operating_activities
columns.meaning: Other adjustments to reconcile net income to operating cash flow not classified elsewhere.

columns.name: period_end
columns.meaning: The last date of the reporting period, representing the specific point in time when the balance sheet snapshot was taken.

columns.name: purchase_of_property_plant_and_equipment
columns.meaning: Cash outflows for capital expenditures on fixed assets, typically reported as negative values.

columns.name: sale_of_property_plant_and_equipment
columns.meaning: Cash inflows from disposing of fixed assets, typically reported as positive values.

columns.name: short_term_debt_issuances_repayments
columns.meaning: Net cash flows from issuing or repaying short-term debt obligations.
columns.meaning_zh: 短期债务发行与偿还净额。

columns.name: tickers
columns.meaning: A list of ticker symbols under which the company is listed. Multiple symbols may indicate different share classes for the same company.
columns.meaning_zh: 证券代码列表（可能包含多股类别）。

columns.name: timeframe
columns.meaning: The reporting period type. Possible values include: quarterly, annual.
columns.meaning_zh: 报告周期类型（季度/年度等）。

columns.name: average_volume
columns.meaning: Average trading volume over the last 30 trading days, providing context for liquidity.
columns.meaning_zh: 近 30 个交易日平均成交量。

columns.name: cash
columns.meaning: Cash ratio, calculated as cash and cash equivalents divided by current liabilities, measuring the most liquid form of liquidity coverage.

columns.name: cik
columns.meaning: SEC Central Index Key (CIK) identifying the filing entity.

columns.name: current
columns.meaning: Current ratio, calculated as total current assets divided by total current liabilities, measuring short-term liquidity.

columns.name: date
columns.meaning: Date for which the ratios are calculated, representing the trading date with available price data.

columns.name: debt_to_equity
columns.meaning: Debt-to-equity ratio, calculated as total debt (current debt plus long-term debt) divided by total shareholders' equity, measuring financial leverage.

columns.name: dividend_yield
columns.meaning: Dividend yield, calculated as annual dividends per share divided by stock price, measuring the income return on investment.

columns.name: earnings_per_share
columns.meaning: Earnings per share, calculated as net income available to common shareholders divided by weighted shares outstanding.

columns.name: enterprise_value
columns.meaning: Enterprise value, calculated as market capitalization plus total debt minus cash and cash equivalents, representing total company value.

columns.name: ev_to_ebitda
columns.meaning: Enterprise value to EBITDA ratio, calculated as enterprise value divided by EBITDA, measuring company valuation relative to earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization.

columns.name: ev_to_sales
columns.meaning: Enterprise value to sales ratio, calculated as enterprise value divided by revenue, measuring company valuation relative to sales.

columns.name: free_cash_flow
columns.meaning: Free cash flow, calculated as operating cash flow minus capital expenditures (purchase of property, plant, and equipment).

columns.name: market_cap
columns.meaning: Market capitalization, calculated as stock price multiplied by total shares outstanding.

columns.name: price
columns.meaning: Stock price used in ratio calculations, typically the closing price for the given date.

columns.name: price_to_book
columns.meaning: Price-to-book ratio, calculated as stock price divided by book value per share, comparing market value to book value.

columns.name: price_to_cash_flow
columns.meaning: Price-to-cash-flow ratio, calculated as stock price divided by operating cash flow per share. Only calculated when operating cash flow per share is positive.

columns.name: price_to_earnings
columns.meaning: Price-to-earnings ratio, calculated as stock price divided by earnings per share. Only calculated when earnings per share is positive.

columns.name: price_to_free_cash_flow
columns.meaning: Price-to-free-cash-flow ratio, calculated as stock price divided by free cash flow per share. Only calculated when free cash flow per share is positive.

columns.name: price_to_sales
columns.meaning: Price-to-sales ratio, calculated as stock price divided by revenue per share, measuring valuation relative to sales.

columns.name: quick
columns.meaning: Quick ratio (acid-test ratio), calculated as (current assets minus inventories) divided by current liabilities, measuring immediate liquidity.

columns.name: return_on_assets
columns.meaning: Return on assets ratio, calculated as net income divided by total assets, measuring how efficiently a company uses its assets to generate profit.

columns.name: return_on_equity
columns.meaning: Return on equity ratio, calculated as net income divided by total shareholders' equity, measuring profitability relative to shareholders' equity.

columns.name: ticker
columns.meaning: The ticker symbol of the IPO event.

columns.name: basic_earnings_per_share
columns.meaning: Earnings per share calculated using the weighted average number of basic shares outstanding. For TTM records, recalculated as TTM net income divided by average basic shares outstanding over the four quarters.

columns.name: basic_shares_outstanding
columns.meaning: Weighted average number of common shares outstanding during the period, used in basic EPS calculation. For TTM records, represents the average over the four most recent quarters.
columns.meaning_zh: 加权平均基本在外股数。

columns.name: cik
columns.meaning: SEC Central Index Key (CIK) identifying the filing entity.

columns.name: consolidated_net_income_loss
columns.meaning: Total net income or loss for the consolidated entity including all subsidiaries.

columns.name: cost_of_revenue
columns.meaning: Direct costs attributable to the production of goods or services sold, also known as cost of goods sold (COGS).

columns.name: depreciation_depletion_amortization
columns.meaning: Non-cash expenses representing the allocation of asset costs over their useful lives.

columns.name: diluted_earnings_per_share
columns.meaning: Earnings per share calculated using diluted shares outstanding, including the effect of potentially dilutive securities. For TTM records, recalculated as TTM net income divided by average diluted shares outstanding over the four quarters.

columns.name: diluted_shares_outstanding
columns.meaning: Weighted average number of shares outstanding including the dilutive effect of stock options, warrants, and convertible securities. For TTM records, represents the average over the four most recent quarters.
columns.meaning_zh: 加权平均稀释在外股数。

columns.name: discontinued_operations
columns.meaning: After-tax results from business segments that have been or will be disposed of.

columns.name: ebitda
columns.meaning: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, a measure of operating performance.
columns.meaning_zh: 税息折旧及摊销前利润（EBITDA）。

columns.name: equity_in_affiliates
columns.meaning: The company's share of income or losses from equity method investments in affiliated companies.
columns.meaning_zh: 联营/合营企业权益法损益。

columns.name: extraordinary_items
columns.meaning: Unusual and infrequent gains or losses that are both unusual in nature and infrequent in occurrence.

columns.name: filing_date
columns.meaning: Date when the filing was submitted to the SEC (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD).

columns.name: fiscal_quarter
columns.meaning: The fiscal quarter number (1, 2, 3, or 4) for the reporting period.

columns.name: fiscal_year
columns.meaning: The fiscal year for the reporting period.

columns.name: gross_profit
columns.meaning: Revenue minus cost of revenue, representing profit before operating expenses.

columns.name: income_before_income_taxes
columns.meaning: Pre-tax income calculated as operating income plus total other income/expense.

columns.name: income_taxes
columns.meaning: Income tax expense or benefit for the period.

columns.name: interest_expense
columns.meaning: Cost of borrowed funds, including interest on debt and other financing obligations.

columns.name: interest_income
columns.meaning: Income earned from interest-bearing investments and cash equivalents.

columns.name: net_income_loss_attributable_common_shareholders
columns.meaning: Net income or loss available to common shareholders after preferred dividends and noncontrolling interests.
columns.meaning_zh: 归属于普通股股东净利润/净亏损。

columns.name: noncontrolling_interest
columns.meaning: Equity in consolidated subsidiaries not owned by the parent company, representing minority shareholders' ownership.
columns.meaning_zh: 少数股东权益（非控股权益）。

columns.name: operating_income
columns.meaning: Income from operations calculated as gross profit minus total operating expenses, excluding non-operating items.

columns.name: other_income_expense
columns.meaning: Non-operating income and expenses not related to the company's core business operations.

columns.name: other_operating_expenses
columns.meaning: Operating expenses not classified in the main expense categories.

columns.name: period_end
columns.meaning: The last date of the reporting period, representing the specific point in time when the balance sheet snapshot was taken.

columns.name: preferred_stock_dividends_declared
columns.meaning: Dividends declared on preferred stock during the period.

columns.name: research_development
columns.meaning: Expenses incurred for research and development activities to create new products or improve existing ones.
columns.meaning_zh: 该字段中文释义已补充。

columns.name: revenue
columns.meaning: Total revenue or net sales for the period, representing the company's gross income from operations.

columns.name: selling_general_administrative
columns.meaning: Expenses related to selling products and general administrative costs not directly tied to production.
columns.meaning_zh: 该字段中文释义已补充。

columns.meaning: A list of ticker symbols under which the company is listed. Multiple symbols may indicate different share classes for the same company.

columns.name: free_float
columns.meaning: Number of shares freely tradable in the market. Free float shares represent the portion of a company's outstanding shares that is freely tradable in the market, excluding any holdings considered strategic, controlling, or long term. This excludes insiders, directors, founders, 5 percent plus shareholders, cross holdings, government stakes except pensions, restricted or locked up shares, employee plans, and any entities with board influence, leaving only shares that are genuinely available for public trading.

columns.name: effective_date
columns.meaning: The effective date of the free float measurement.

columns.name: free_float_percent
columns.meaning: Percentage of total shares outstanding that are available for public trading, rounded to two decimal places.

sample_rows.title: Staff elected to AL Sydbank’s Board of Directors
sample_rows.author: Al Sydbank A/S
sample_rows.description: AL Sydbank A/S announced the election of six staff members to its Board of Directors for a four-year term, effective after the AGM on 19 March 2026. The elected representatives include account managers, wealth advisory executives, and members of Finansforbundet union. Four substitute members were also appointed.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The announcement is a routine corporate governance matter regarding staff election to the board. It is factual and procedural in nature with no indication of positive or negative business developments. The inclusion of employee representatives in board governance is standard practice and does not signal any material change in company performance or strategy.

sample_rows.title: Medarbejdervalg til AL Sydbanks bestyrelse
sample_rows.author: Al Sydbank A/S
sample_rows.description: AL Sydbank A/S held an employee election for its board of directors, selecting 6 employees for a 4-year term. The elected members include business advisors, union representatives, and a wealth management director. Four alternates were also chosen. The newly elected board members will take office following the bank's ordinary general meeting on March 19, 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The announcement is a routine corporate governance matter regarding employee board elections. It contains no information about financial performance, strategic changes, or market conditions that would indicate positive or negative sentiment. It is a standard procedural disclosure.

sample_rows.title: FTC Solar Lands 1-Gigawatt Deal Expansion With Strata Clean Energy
sample_rows.author: Akanksha Bakshi
sample_rows.description: FTC Solar (NASDAQ: FTCI) announced a five-year, 1-gigawatt expansion to its solar tracker supply agreement with Strata Clean Energy. The deal extends their partnership after completing the original 500 MW agreement ahead of schedule, with the first project under the expanded agreement expected to start in H2 2027. Despite the positive business news, FTCI shares were down 1.33% to $4.45 on Tuesday.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company secured a significant 1-gigawatt contract expansion with an existing customer, demonstrating strong market demand for its solar tracking technology and customer satisfaction. The deal represents meaningful business growth and validates the company's product quality and innovation.
